doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

title: Uncle Amos Martin, bass horn player born in slavery
summary: Asked about musical parents, Martin names an uncle, Amos Martin, who played bass horn and drowned before Martin was born. He does not know what band Amos played in.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: About where George Lewis lives now, down in that section. Down in that section. Did your parents play any musical instruments?
I had an uncle, Amos, he played music. That was before I was born. Yes. What instrument did he play? He played bass horn. Bass. Amos Martin.
Do you remember what band he played with? Did you hear what bands he played with?
No, I never did know the band. That was before I was born.
See, he was born in slavery, Amos.
And your father didn't play anything then? No. Or your mother, did she play any instrument or sing? I guess she would sing probably.
